method.conditions: Fresh database and browser per invocation. Authenticated HTTP seeding. Chromium headless software renderer, device scale 1, 1280 by 800 CSS pixels. Existing view restored at 100% for the sparse and dense region. Seed submission and crop encoding excluded from interactive measurements.
method.corpus: Repeat [32,64,96,128] samples per stroke. All objects store Quickdraw points and Folio seven-channel pressure/tilt/twist/tangentialPressure records. Standard corpus has 16 sparse and 1000 dense visible strokes on the same board. Native gestures are added at a disjoint screen locus for each pass.
method.observations: pointerToInkFill measures time from the latest captured physical CDP pen event to the synchronous Canvas2D fill for that gesture’s unique color; coalesced events are counted separately. pointerToFollowingRaf records the timestamp in the following RAF callback. Neither is display hardware latency. rAFIntervalsDuringWriting includes gesture/commit transitions. penReleaseToDurableObserved starts before dispatching pen-up and polls the live SQLite database from an independent thread approximately every 8ms. warmJsHeapMiB is runtime.getHeapUsage for the JS isolate, without forcing GC.
method.experimentalOrder: First four run records are a B-A-A-B cross-over for the first optimization against the original build. The second pair reverses region order. Iteration 2 has an independent 5-gesture dense repeat. Engineering probes share the same machine; CPU scheduling and automatic GC remain uncontrolled. Per-run raw arrays provided.
method.raster: Same direct Chromium screenshot crop, CSS coordinate x=180 y=150 width=875 height=460; decoded RGB compared at every pixel, no resizing. Independent 1016-record standard viewport for A/B; step2 dense graphics correspond to identical visible geometry in 4096-record standard board.
method.guards: Each gesture must persist a uniquely colored editable stroke with varied pressure/tilt/tangential pressure. Reload must restore object count, page must report zero errors. Separate quota probe uses actual authenticated requests until a rejected single record, then matches SQLite item count against accepted writes.
method.samplePercentiles: Nearest-rank p95 within each run. Median uses arithmetic mean of the two middle values for even counts. Raw observations include no synthetic frames.
method.controls: Use CHROMIUM_PATH and BUN_PATH to pin binaries; command examples require Python Playwright, Pillow and Bun. Optional --quota and --raster-dir generate quota and screenshot evidence. Near quota CLI: --count 8192 --dense-visible 4000 --region dense. Only the first baseline lap used --quota.
